description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a news page with blog posts, recent blog entries, pagination, and header/footer includes. It integrates multiple models and libraries to generate dynamic content for a news section.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A utility class for paginating results, providing methods to fetch rows and generate navigation links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes paginated results with total items, items per page, and current page.

methods.name: fetchPagedRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row for the current page.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets the layout for pagination navigation.

methods.name: fetchPagedNavigation
methods.description: Returns HTML for pagination navigation links.

methods.name: Text::get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized or static text string by key.

methods.name: Text::recorta
methods.description: Truncates text to a specified length with ellipsis.

methods.name: Post::getAll
methods.description: Fetches all blog posts with optional limit and offset.
